title: 第23章 就这么简单第24章 斯塔文的传说
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 傍晚时分，暮色森林的天空愈发阴沉，远处传来乌鸦的啼叫声。
旅馆内，艾伦坐在床上，看了一眼窗外，又看了看手上的披风。
那是温雷在他昏迷的这一天多时间里，和夜色镇的制皮匠一起赶制出来的。
他听温雷说，众人都同意把这件披风给他。
【鲁伯斯的皮】
背部「优秀品质」
18点护甲
+2耐力
+3敏捷
就在这时，门外传来轻轻的敲门声。
“普瑞斯托先生，我是夜色镇的书记员，您和您同伴们的赏金到了，方便进来吗？”
已经到了和书记员约好的领赏金的时间了吗？
艾伦没有回答，而是迅速将披风系好。
虽然没有人回答，但门还是被推开了。
书记员走了进来，戴着一副金丝边眼镜，穿着一身剪裁得体的深色礼服，还是那样儒雅。
他的手里提着一个相当大的推箱，足有半人高，看起来沉甸甸的。
看见艾伦坐着，书记员略微有些惊讶，
“普瑞斯托先生，您竟然已经醒了？”
艾伦看着那个箱子，挑了挑眉：“书记员先生，一个金币需要用这么大的箱子装吗？”
“先生，我必须提醒您，暮色森林非常危险，让自己落单可不是件好事。”
书记员微微一笑，他随手将箱子放在地上，然后不慌不忙地整理了一下自己的衣领和袖口，动作优雅得像是坐在贵族沙龙里。
“如果你指望的是楼下那个憨傻的圣骑士的话，我只能告诉你，他已经睡着了。”
艾伦冷笑一声，也不再演戏，他指着对方的衣袖，声音里带着毫不掩饰的讥讽：
“我早该注意到的。只是没有想到，你竟然禽兽到杀了雇主一家，还要穿着雇主家的衣服四处晃悠。”
书记员那身深色礼服的袖口上，绣着一个不显眼的纹章，一面盾牌，盾面上有三道波浪形的斜纹。
德·蒙莫朗西家的家徽，这是德·蒙莫朗西家的衣服。
昏迷之前，艾伦在万千丝缕中看到了斯塔文的脚印，最终通向了夜色镇的治安官办公室。
于是艾伦就在自己的记忆殿堂中，播放了他刚刚来到夜色镇的那一幕，他在记忆中注意到，那位书记员在见到他们一行人的时候扯了扯袖口，这一次，他看到了那袖口的徽记。
书记员脸上的笑容没有变，只是那双藏在镜片后面的眼睛，陡然变得幽深起来。

In the evening, the sky in the twilight forest becomes increasingly gloomy, and the crow of crows can be heard in the distance.
In the hotel, Allen sat on the bed, glanced out the window, and then looked at the cloak in his hand.
It was made by Wen Lei and the leatherworkers in Night Town during the day or so when he was in coma.
He heard from Wen Lei that everyone agreed to give him the cloak.
【Rubbers' Skin】
"Excellent quality" on the back
18 points of armor
+2 stamina
+3 agility
At this moment, there was a gentle knock on the door.
"Mr. Presto, I am the clerk of Night Town. The bounty for you and your companions has arrived. Is it convenient for you to come in?"
Has it come time to collect the bounty as agreed with the clerk?
Allen didn't answer, but quickly tied up his cloak.
"Physique 11" → "Physique 13"!
"Agility 11" → "Agility 14"!
Although no one answered, the door was pushed open.
The clerk walked in, wearing a pair of gold-rimmed glasses and a well-tailored dark dress, still as elegant as ever.
He was holding a rather large push box in his hand, which was half a person tall and looked heavy.
Seeing Allen sitting, the clerk was slightly surprised.
"Mr. Presto, you are actually awake?"
Allen looked at the box and raised his eyebrows: "Mr. Clerk, does a gold coin need to be packed in such a big box?"
"Sir, I must remind you that Dusk Forest is very dangerous and it is not a good thing to leave yourself alone."
The clerk smiled slightly, put the box on the ground casually, and then tidied his collar and cuffs calmly, as elegantly as if he were sitting in a noble salon.
"If you are counting on the stupid paladin downstairs, I can only tell you that he is already asleep."
Allen sneered and stopped acting. He pointed at the other party's sleeves with undisguised sarcasm in his voice:
"I should have noticed it earlier. I just didn't expect that you would be such a beast as to kill your employer's family and wander around in your employer's clothes."
On the cuffs of the clerk's dark dress, there is an inconspicuous coat of arms embroidered on it, a shield with three wavy diagonal stripes on the shield.
The coat of arms of the de Montmorency family. This is the clothing of the de Montmorency family.
Before falling into coma, Allen saw Stavin's footprints among thousands of clues, which eventually led to the Sheriff's Office in Night Town.
So Allen played the scene when he just arrived in Night Town in his memory hall. He noticed in his memory that the clerk tugged on his cuffs when he saw their group. This time, he saw the emblem on the cuffs.
The smile on the clerk's face did not change, but the eyes hidden behind the lenses suddenly became darker.
